summary: Macerich Co filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered offering of 14,000,000 shares of common stock at $23.90 per share, via forward sale agreements with underwriters. The company will not initially receive proceeds; physical settlement is expected within 12 months, with cash or net-share settlement as alternatives. The offering is an ordinary equity raise, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal-specific catalysts are present. This is a routine takedown under an existing shelf registration.
